title: Reinforced Planning with Latent World Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.18669v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Humans solve complex problems by constructing plans and mentally simulating their outcomes with an internal model of the world. Machine learning has produced world models that similarly predict the outcomes of action sequences, but the improvement of candidate plans still isn't fully learned. Current planners are either hand-designed, distilled from a hand-designed optimizer, or learned only to inform an amortized policy rather than to revise the plan itself. We introduce the Reinforced Planning, a method based on the idea that search can be learned by reinforcing good search rules into a neural planner. Our implementation RP1 learns both how to evaluate imagined outcomes through a critic, as well as how to improve multi-step plans through an optimizer trained fully offline from imagined world-model roll-outs. translated_title: 基于潜在世界模型的强化规划
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18669v1 公告类型：新 摘要：人类通过构建计划并利用内部世界模型在心理上模拟其结果来解决复杂问题。机器学习已经产生了能够类似预测行动序列结果的世界模型，但候选计划的改进仍未完全学习。当前的规划器要么是手工设计的，要么是从手工设计的优化器中提炼出来的，要么仅被学习用于告知摊销策略，而非修订计划本身。我们引入了强化规划（Reinforced Planning），这是一种基于将搜索规则强化学习到神经规划器中的思想的方法。我们的实现RP1学习如何通过评论家评估想象的结果，以及如何通过完全离线从想象的世界模型推出中训练的优化器来改进多步计划。据我们所知，RP1是首个完全学习如何改进多步计划的方法。此外，它可以独立训练。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为强化规划（RP1）的新方法，首次实现了完全通过强化学习来改进多步计划，利用潜在世界模型离线训练优化器，无需手工设计规划规则。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Reinforced Planning (RP1), the first method to fully learn how to improve multi-step plans by reinforcing search rules into a neural planner, trained offline from latent world-model roll-outs.
